verses.zh: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。
verses.en: What follows is the account of Esau (also known as Edom).[NOTE:1]
notes: Chapter 36 records what became of Esau. It will list both his actual descendants as well as the people he subsumed under his tribal leadership, people who were aboriginal Edomites. The chapter is long and complicated (see further J. R. Bartlett, “The Edomite King-List of Genesis 36:31-39 and 1 Chronicles 1:43-50, ” JTS 16 [1965]: 301-14; and W. J. Horowitz, “Were There Twelve Horite Tribes?” CBQ 35 [1973]: 69-71). In the format of the Book of Genesis, the line of Esau is “tidied up” before the account of Jacob is traced (37:2). As such the arrangement makes a strong contrast with Jacob. As F. Delitzsch says, “secular greatness in general grows up far more rapidly than spiritual greatness” (New Commentary on Genesis, 2:238). In other words, the progress of the world far out distances the progress of the righteous who are waiting for the promise.

verses.zh: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大和希未人祭便的孙女、亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，
verses.en: Esau took his wives from the Canaanites:[NOTE:1] Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah and granddaughter[NOTE:2] of Zibeon the Hivite,
notes: Heb “from the daughters of Canaan.”
Heb “daughter,” but see Gen 36:24-25.

verses.zh: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿、尼拜约的妹子巴实抹。
verses.en: in addition to Basemath the daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

verses.zh: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；
verses.en: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,

verses.zh: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。这都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.en: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

verses.zh: 以扫带着他的妻子、儿女，与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切货财，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别处去，离了他兄弟雅各。
verses.en: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, all the people in his household, his livestock, his animals, and all his possessions that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went to a land some distance away from[NOTE:1] Jacob his brother
notes: Heb “from before.”

verses.zh: 因为二人的财物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他们，所以不能同居。
verses.en: because they had too many possessions to be able to stay together, and the land where they had settled[NOTE:1] was not able to support them because of their livestock.
notes: Heb “land of their settlements.”

verses.zh: 于是以扫住在西珥山里；以扫就是以东。
verses.en: So Esau (also known as Edom) lived in the hill country of Seir.[NOTE:1]
notes: Traditionally “Mount Seir,” but in this case the expression בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר (behar seʿir) refers to the hill country or highlands of Seir.

verses.zh: 以扫是西珥山里以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。
verses.en: This is the account of Esau, the father[NOTE:1] of the Edomites, in the hill country of Seir.
notes: The term father in genealogical records needs to be carefully defined. It can refer to a literal father, a grandfather, a political overlord, or a founder.

verses.zh: 以扫众子的名字如下。以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。
verses.en: These were the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.

verses.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯。
verses.en: These were the sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.zh: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。这是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。
verses.en: Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These were the sons[NOTE:1] of Esau’s wife Adah.
notes: Or “grandsons” (NIV); “descendants” (NEB).

verses.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。这是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.en: These were the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons[NOTE:1] of Esau’s wife Basemath.
notes: Or “grandsons” (NIV); “descendants” (NEB).

verses.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛是祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿；她给以扫生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。
verses.en: These were the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah the daughter of Anah and granddaughter[NOTE:1] of Zibeon: She bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah to Esau.
notes: Heb “daughter,” but see Gen 36:24-25.

verses.zh: 以扫子孙中作族长的记在下面。以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长、阿抹族长、洗玻族长、基纳斯族长、
verses.en: These were the chiefs[NOTE:1] among the descendants[NOTE:2] of Esau, the sons of Eliphaz, Esau’s firstborn: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
notes: Or “clan leaders” (so also throughout this chapter).
Or “sons.”

verses.zh: 可拉族长、迦坦族长、亚玛力族长。这是在以东地从以利法所出的族长，都是亚大的子孙。
verses.en: chief Korah,[NOTE:1] chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons[NOTE:2] of Adah.
notes: Smr omits the name “Korah” (see v. 11 and 1 Chr 1:36).
Or “grandsons” (NIV); “descendants” (NEB).

verses.zh: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长、谢拉族长、沙玛族长、米撒族长。这是在以东地从流珥所出的族长，都是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.en: These were the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom; these were the sons[NOTE:1] of Esau’s wife Basemath.
notes: Or “grandsons” (NIV); “descendants” (NEB).

verses.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长、雅兰族长、可拉族长。这是从以扫妻子，亚拿的女儿，阿何利巴玛子孙中所出的族长。
verses.en: These were the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

verses.zh: 以上的族长都是以扫的子孙；以扫就是以东。
verses.en: These were the sons of Esau (also known as Edom), and these were their chiefs.

verses.zh: 那地原有的居民―何利人西珥的子孙记在下面：就是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、
verses.en: These were the sons of Seir the Horite,[NOTE:1] who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
notes: The same pattern of sons, grandsons, and chiefs is now listed for Seir the Horite. “Seir” is both the name of the place and the name of the ancestor of these tribes. The name “Horite” is probably not to be identified with “Hurrian.” The clan of Esau settled in this area, intermarried with these Horites and eventually dispossessed them, so that they all became known as Edomites (Deut 2:12 telescopes the whole development).

verses.zh: 底顺、以察、底珊。这是从以东地的何利人西珥子孙中所出的族长。
verses.en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, the descendants[NOTE:1] of Seir in the land of Edom.
notes: Or “sons.”

verses.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利、希幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。
verses.en: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Homam;[NOTE:1] Lotan’s sister was Timna.
notes: Heb “Hemam”; this is probably a variant spelling of “Homam” (1 Chr 1:39); cf. NRSV, NLT “Heman.”

verses.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示玻、阿南。
verses.en: These were the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho,[NOTE:1] and Onam.
notes: This name is given as “Shephi” in 1 Chr 1:40.

verses.zh: 祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿（当时在旷野放他父亲祭便的驴，遇着温泉的，就是这亚拿）。
verses.en: These were the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah (who discovered the hot springs[NOTE:1] in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of his father Zibeon).
notes: The meaning of this Hebrew term is uncertain; Syriac reads “water” and Vulgate reads “hot water.”

verses.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。
verses.en: These were the children[NOTE:1] of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
notes: Heb “sons,” but since a daughter is included in the list, the word must be translated “children.”

verses.zh: 底顺的儿子是欣但、伊是班、益兰、基兰。
verses.en: These were the sons of Dishon:[NOTE:1] Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.
notes: Heb “Dishan,” but this must be either a scribal error or variant spelling, since “Dishan” is mentioned in v. 28 (see also v. 21).

verses.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。
verses.en: These were the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.zh: 底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。
verses.en: These were the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.zh: 从何利人所出的族长记在下面：就是罗坍族长、朔巴族长、祭便族长、亚拿族长、
verses.en: These were the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

verses.zh: 底顺族长、以察族长、底珊族长。这是从何利人所出的族长，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族长。
verses.en: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, chief Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chief lists in the land of Seir.

verses.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以东地作王的记在下面。
verses.en: These were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites:[NOTE:1]
notes: Or perhaps “before any Israelite king ruled over [them].”

verses.zh: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.en: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
verses.en: When Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.

verses.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。
verses.en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

verses.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.en: When Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated the Midianites in the land of Moab, reigned in his place; the name of his city was Avith.

verses.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
verses.en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.

verses.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。
verses.en: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the River[NOTE:1] reigned in his place.
notes: Typically the Hebrew expression “the River” refers to the Euphrates River, but it is not certain whether that is the case here. Among the modern English versions which take this as a reference to the Euphrates are NASB, NCV, NRSV, CEV, NLT. Cf. NAB, TEV “Rehoboth-on-the-River.”

verses.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒・哈南接续他作王。
verses.en: When Shaul died, Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

verses.zh: 亚革波的儿子巴勒・哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的京城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米・萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
verses.en: When Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, Hadad[NOTE:1] reigned in his place; the name of his city was Pau.[NOTE:2] His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
notes: Most mss of the MT read “Hadar” here; “Hadad” is the reading found in some Hebrew mss, Smr, and Syriac (cf. also 1 Chr 1:50).
The name of the city is given as “Pai” in 1 Chr 1:50.

verses.zh: 从以扫所出的族长，按着他们的宗族、住处、名字记在下面：就是亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、
verses.en: These were the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families, according to their places, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

verses.zh: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、
verses.en: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

verses.zh: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、
verses.en: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

verses.zh: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这是以东人在所得为业的地上，按着他们的住处。〈所有的族长都是以东人的始祖以扫的后代。〉
verses.en: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements[NOTE:1] in the land they possessed. This was Esau, the father of the Edomites.
notes: Or perhaps “territories”; Heb “dwelling places.”
